master: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: CosCircle Mimi mascot main sprite, transparent. Reference image is existing Mimi identity, NOT level of detail. Redesign her to MUCH MORE ABSTRACT, extremely simple actual 64x64 pixel game sprite, a tiny cozy 8-bit character. Full-body centered with transparent margins, huge simple white hair silhouette and large head, small indigo jacket/body, mint star hairclip and mint cuffs, lavender boots, just one small cream badge. Long hair as TWO OR THREE big block shapes, no individual strands. Remove ALL pockets, belts, backpack straps, jewelry and ticket; one simple friendly waving hand. At most 12 flat opaque colors, hard square pixel clusters on EXACTLY 64x64 logical grid, 1-pixel dark purple outline. If output larger use uniform integer magnification of that64px grid. Face only a few pixels: two simple lavender eyes and tiny friendly smile, no detailed anime eyelashes or iris shading. Mimi is a wholesome cute teenage alien girl, fully covered clothes, same white hair and mint star identity as reference. Readable at actual64px. No gradients, antialiasing, texture, glow or stray colored pixels. No words, text, letters, numbers, punctuation, watermark, border or scenery. One sprite only.
